A Special Note from Angie!

Nothing that is aligned reaches you by accident. You are here because your time has come! It’s your time for clarity, success, and positivity!

Well-being comes from living in right relationship with the earth beneath our feet, the air that carries our prayers, the fire that transforms, and the waters that cleanse and renew. When this balance is disturbed, life feels heavy, delayed, or closed. When it is restored, the way forward opens naturally.

My work follows these ancestral understandings. Every ritual kit, herb, and fortified item is prepared in respect of natural law and spiritual order. These are not ordinary items; they are supports for alignment, clearing, and steady movement forward.

I prepare each piece personally, with minimal handling, focused intention, and reverence for the elements involved. Nothing is rushed. Nothing is interfered with. What you receive has been worked with carefully, so its purpose remains clear and undisturbed.

May what you receive help return you to balance.
May the elements support your steps.
May your path open as it is meant to.

With Love and Intention,
Angie

A. SHIPPING INFO

1. STANDARD DELIVERY

Standard delivery operates weekdays (Mon–Fri) from 8am to 6pm.
All orders within the United Kingdom (UK) takes approximately 3–5 working days.

HerbByTifah Pick-up Points:
Dagenham (RM10) & Barking (IG11)

Opening Hours:
Monday to Saturday: 8am — 7:30pm
Sunday: 10am – 4pm

2. NEXT DAY DELIVERY

Need HBT products a.s.a.p.? This service is only available to London, Essex, Luton, Milton Keynes & North Hampton in the United Kingdom (UK) for a fee of £10 — £15.

NOTE: Next working day delivery needs to be placed by/before 1pm via WhatsApp (you can click here), to be received the following day. Valid for weekdays only.
Under 1kg – £10
1kg and above – £15

3. INTERNATIONAL DELIVERY

Good news, we can deliver your items abroad.
Please note, we have no control over taxes and duties. Shipping cost does not include tax. Customs in the respective countries determines duties and taxes to be paid.

There is no Next Day delivery for international deliveries.

 

B. POSTAGE/DELIVERY POLICY

ORDER, MAKE PAYMENT & SELECT PICK-UP POINT

  • Please allow up to (24 hours Mon–Fri) (48 hours, Sat–Sun) after order confirmation to receive pick up notification.
  • Once your order is ready for pickup, you’ll receive a text message with the pickup details.
  • Ensure you enter your correct mobile number & email.

All UK orders are posted via Royal Mail.

Reliability is key, which is why we use Royal Mail Tracked 24 delivery, with full tracking from end-to-end.

Please make sure you or someone you know will be present either at your home or work address to accept your delivery.

At HerbsByTifah, we do our best to deliver within the stated time, however we cannot be held responsible for any delays caused by the customs clearance of the destination country.
We try our best to get deliveries out to you on time, but sometimes international deliveries can take longer than expected.

 

KINDLY NOTE THAT:
i.  HerbsByTifah will not be responsible for:

  • Missed delivery
  • Wrong address as a result of address given on order.
  • Should your order be undelivered or damaged. Tracking information will be provided.

 

ii.  HerbsByTifah will file a claim with Royal Mail for undelivered/damages item (10 days after the expected delivery date)

  • You will receive the proof of completed claim on Royal Mail website and allow 30 days for it to be dealt with.
  • You will be notified about the outcome of the claim after Royal Mail investigation, If successful.

 

  • 1st class recorded delivery maximum pay out on a claim is £50 per parcel.
  • Should your purchase exceed £50, consider splitting the order to cover a maximum of £50 compensation per order.
  • Exceeding £50 per order means you agree to accept the Royal Mail maximum pay.

 

  • HerbsByTifah will not be responsible for paying the difference.

 

C. REFUNDS, RETURNS, AND EXCHANGES

1. RETURNS

We do not accept returns or offer refunds. T&Cs apply.

2. EXCHANGES

Our policy allows for order changes within 2 hours of purchase, but the new order must be of equal value to the initial order, and no refunds will be issued for any price difference.

2. ORDER CANCELLATION

We understand that sometimes circumstances change and orders might need to be cancelled. Therefore, if you need to cancel your order, we offer a cancellation window of 24 hours, during which time you can receive a refund minus a cancellation fee of £1.45. Please note that after the 24-hour window has passed, cancellations will no longer be possible, and refunds will not be issued.

3. SALE ITEMS

All sale items are not returnable for exchange or refund.

 

D. INSURANCE

HerbsByTifah insures each purchase during the time it is in transit until it is delivered to you.

For all deliveries, we require a signature, at which point responsibility for your purchased products passes to you (i.e, on the receipt of your purchase).

Not the receiver of the purchase? If you got your items as a gift or something similar, then the person who signs for the package and confirms receipt and is accountable for the package.

 

SOME USEFUL TIPS:

  • Our delivery time starts from the moment an order is accepted. This includes a period where your items will be processed and dispatched by us. Please note, it may take up to 48 hours for shipments to be dispatched.
  • We’re all about good relationships, and we work closely with our shipping partner to minimize the potential impact of custom delays on our international customers.
  • To minimize delays, we recommend using a valid address as your delivery address.
